title: The Memberships tab is five short views and the event list folds

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20 in the project chat: the offerings and money page is a joke, make menus or compact areas and space it well (PR 2 of 3 after LIVE-1175)

detail: FILED 2026-10-20. THE CONSEQUENCE: even inside its own tab the Memberships body stacked the tier editor with its long textareas, member benefits, circle access, a 30 row event list and the members table into one scroll. THE FIX: a `?view=` bar (Plans, Benefits, Circles, Event access, Members) renders one editor at a time, and the event list shows 8 rows with Show all. Every form and action is unchanged; Frequency keeps its plan cards and members table leading the Plans view and has no separate Members view. See ADR-1871.

verify.note: Fails on main (editors stack in one body), passes with this change.
